{{nutritionsummary|1/2 of recipe (380 g)|2|912|574|63.8 g|39.4 g|102 mg|1207 mg|37.1 g|1.7 g|5.6 g|47.3 g|6%|5%|41%|7%}}
==Ingredients==
* ¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (85 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]/3 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) dried [[Cookbook:Pasta|pasta]] (whatever shape you like)
* ¼ cup ({{convert|75|g|oz|disp=s|abbr=on}}) [[Cookbook:Cream Cheese|cream cheese]]
* ¾ cup ({{convert|75|g|oz|disp=s|abbr=on}}) [[Cookbook:Grater|grated]] [[Cookbook:Mozzarella Cheese|mozzarella cheese]]
* ¾ cup ({{convert|75|g|oz|disp=s|abbr=on}}) grated [[Cookbook:Cheddar Cheese|cheddar cheese]]
* 2½–3½ [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Hoisin Sauce|hoisin sauce]] to taste
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] ({{convert|125|g|oz|disp=s|abbr=on}}) [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] cooked [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]]
* ½ cup ({{convert|125|ml|USoz|disp=s|abbr=on}}) [[Cookbook:Heavy Cream|heavy whipping cream]]

==Procedure==
#Bring a pot of water to the [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]]. Add the pasta and cook for about 10 minutes (or until the pasta is soft).
#Drain the pasta so that no water remains in the pan. Return drained pasta to the pot.
#Add the cream, cheeses, chicken, and hoisin sauce to the pasta.
#Cook for a few minutes to warm everything through.
#Serve.
